stops.note: a Berber word for a slender throwing spear used across North Africa
Arabic absorbed the Berber word along with its definite article
Portuguese explorers adopted the term while trading along the African coast
entered English through accounts of southern African warfare, especially Zulu weaponry
stops.meaning: a slender, iron-tipped spear used by southern African peoples

current_meaning: A slender, iron-tipped spear historically used as a stabbing or throwing weapon by southern African peoples such as the Zulu.
